title: Hyderabad Anime India Convention Hosts Bleach Director Noriyuki Abe as Guest on November 14-15
content:
The convention will host the next Kolkata event on February 27-28.

Naruto director Hayato Date ( Naruto Shippūden , Flame of Recca ) attended the Mumbai 2026 event as a guest. Voice actor Akari Yura ( The Beginning After The End , Catch Me at the Ballpark! ) performed as a musical act at the convention's concert, and Luna Goami ( Sparks of Tomorrow ) and Mofmofmo performed at the concert. ASCA ( Sword Art Online: Alicization , Edens Zero ) also performed at the event. Producer Ryōta Hasegawa ( Dr. Stone , Sakamoto Days ) attended the event as a guest. The event hosted meet and greets for all four musical artists as well as with Ryōta Hasegawa . Kadokawa participated in a "fireside chat" in the event's Animation & More Summit, as did ' Sony YAY!'

Anime India hosted voice actor Kazuhiko Inoue ( Naruto , Parasyte -the maxim- , 2025 Ranma ½ ) as a guest at its event in Delhi. Delhi Anime India took place at Yashobhoomi Convention Centre on June 6 and June 7. YURiKA ( Little Witch Academia , Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department ) performed at the event as well.

Anime India hosted its Kolkata event at Biswa Bangla Mela Prangan on February 14 and February 15. The event featured a panel and a workshop by director Susumu Mitsunaka ( Haikyu!! director, Weathering With You key animator).

Voice actor Tsunko ( D4DJ First Mix , D4DJ All Mix ), president of Avex Pictures ' Hideo Katsumata , and DJ Tōko Nakamura also attended the event as guests. Hikari Dobashi attended the event as an exhibitor representing TV Tokyo .

title: AFA Singapore Adds Kagurabachi Anime as Featured Anime
content:
Shochiku , CyberAgent , and the Anime Festival Asia convention announced on Monday that the "world tour" television anime of Takeru Hokazono 's Kagurabachi manga will enter its "third part" by being featured as a part of the AFA Singapore convention. The anime will feature in the convention on November 29 with a talk event.

The AFA Singapore convention will take place at the Suntec Singapore International Convention and Exhibition Centre in Singapore on November 27 to 29.

Viz Media 's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service are releasing the Kagurabachi manga digitally in English. MANGA Plus describes the story:

Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge. Epic sword battle action!

The anime stars:

• Taihi Kimura as Chihiro Rokuhira

• Tomokazu Seki as Kunishige Rokuhira

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Togo Shiba

• Miku Itō as Hinao

• Miyari Nemoto as Char Kyonagi

Tetsuya Takeuchi ( From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated! director; key animator for Naruto and Naruto Shippūden ) is directing the anime at Cypic ( The World Is Dancing ). Keigo Sasaki (character designer for Blue Exorcist , Uma Musume: Cinderella Gray ) is designing the characters. Shochiku and CyberAgent are on the production committee .

The anime will premiere in April 2027, and will stream that month worldwide excluding Japan, Mainland China, North Korea, and South Korea. The "world tour" event for the anime began this past July at Anime Expo in Los Angeles, Japan Expo Paris in Paris, ANImagic in Mannheim, Germany, and in August at Anime NYC in New York. The event is showing the first 20 minutes of the first episode, and will end in Japan in spring 2027 where the full first episode will be screened.
author: ANN

title: Phoenix Gramedia Licenses Silent Hill f Novel
content:
Kadokawa and Gramedia's Phoenix Gramedia company announced on Tuesday that it has licensed Shiro Kuro 's novelization of Silent Hill f , the recent spinoff game for the Silent Hill franchise , and will release it in Indonesia "soon."

The novelization originally released in Japan in October 2025.

The Silent Hill f game launched for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC on September 25, 2025. The game had exceeded 1 million units in cumulative worldwide shipments, as of September 26. The cumulative total includes physical copies and digital downloads of the game.

Ryukishi07 ( Higurashi: When They Cry ) wrote the story, and kera designed the creatures and characters. Motoi Okamoto produced the game, and Neobards Entertainment ( Resident Evil Re:Verse ) developed the game.

Ame Gōkin launched a manga adaptation with a new ending from Ryukishi07 on Kadokawa 's Young Ace Up manga website on April 22.

Silent Hill f is also inspiring a new manga spinoff focused on the Fox Mask character in the Weekly Famitsu magazine in late 2026. The story is supervised by the game's original writer Ryukishi07 and Konami . The manga will have two separate parts, with the first part depicting the origin story of Fox Mask. New artist Ayato will draw the manga.
author: ANN

title: Madoka Magica -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- Anime Film Opens in Singapore on October 31
content:
Aniplus Asia announced on Tuesday that it will open Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie: Walpurgisnacht: Rising ( Gekijōban Mahō Shōjo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten ), the official sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion film, in Singapore on October 31.

Yukihiro Miyamoto ( Puella Magi Madoka Magica , Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story , Arakawa Under the Bridge ) directed the film.

The returning cast includes:

• Aoi Yūki as Madoka Kaname

• Chiwa Saitō as Homura Akemi

• Kaori Mizuhashi as Mami Tomoe

• Eri Kitamura as Sayaka Miki

• Ai Nonaka as Kyōko Sakura

• Kana Asumi as Nagisa Momoe

• Emiri Katō as Kyubey

Shion Wakayama voices the new magical girl Shichōka, and Tomoyo Kurosawa voices Selma Therese. Maaya Sakamoto plays the unnamed upperclassman, or Wasu, who looks like Homura but nobody knows her true name or identity.

The anime film features a returning staff from the original anime series and films, including original creators Magica Quartet , chief director Akiyuki Simbo , scriptwriter Gen Urobuchi of Nitroplus , original character designer Ume Aoki , animation character designer Junichirō Taniguchi , composer Yuki Kajiura , alternate space designer Gekidan Inu Curry , and animation studio SHAFT .

The new and returning staff members are:

• Chief Animation Directors: Junichirō Taniguchi, Hiroki Yamamura

• storyboard/Visual Concept Design: Tomohiro Furukawa (new)

• Visual Concept Design: Kazuki Kawada

• Color Key Artist: Jin Hibino

• Art: Ken Naitō (returnng), Shūichi Kusamori (new)

• Art Setting: Morihito Ōhara

• Compositing Director of Photography: Takayuki Aizu

• Editing: Rie Matsubara

• Sound Director: Yōta Tsuruoka

Yuki Kajiura 's solo project FictionJunction perform the theme song "Kanata."

SHAFT first hinted at a new work in the franchise through a concept movie in 2015, but the film was only announced in April 2021.

The film has suffered numerous previous delays, the most recent of which happened in January due to production circumstances, delaying the movie from a planned opening in February. Prior to this most recent delay, the film was previously slated to open in Japan in winter 2024, but was delayed in August 2024 to winter 2025, before the delay to February 2026.

The television edition of the Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 1: Beginnings and Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 2: Eternal compilation films began airing in October 2025.

The original 12-episode Puella Magi Madoka Magica television anime premiered in January 2011. The Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 1: Beginnings and Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part 2: Eternal compilation films opened in Japan in October 2012, and then the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion sequel film opened in October 2013.

A television anime adaptation of the Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story smartphone game premiered in January 2020. The anime's second season premiered in July 2021. The third and final season debuted in April 2022.

The smartphone game launched for iOS and Android devices in Japan in August 2017, and was free to play with optional in-game purchases. The English version launched in the United States and Canada in June 2019. The English version of the game ended service in September 2020, and the Japanese version ended service in July 2024.

The Puella Magi Madoka Magica : Magia Exedra smartphone game launched in March 2025, following a delay from 2024 for the staff to "ensure even higher quality in the final game." The game got a version for PC via Steam in July 2025.
author: ANN

title: Ani-One Asia Licenses Dark Machine the Animation Series
content:
Ani-One Asia announced on Tuesday that it will stream Dark Machine the Animation , the original anime for the Dark Machine game and anime project , beginning on October 14 at 2:15 a.m. GMT +8. Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

The globally popular esports game Dark Machine has sparked immense enthusiasm among the public. Golden Valley is the only city in Japan designated as a Dark Machine Special Economic Zone. Ruling at the top of this district is Ajima, the seventh-generation successor to the title of “Senki,” bestowed upon the strongest Dark Machine player. The protagonist, Kairi, visits Golden Valley, holding fast to his late grandfather's final words: “Seek out Senki.” There, he happens to encounter a girl named Rudra, who is being pursued by Ajima's subordinate, Arudabiru. After getting caught up in Rudra's troubles, Kairi becomes a Dark Machine player himself. Through a series of fierce battles, his latent talent gradually begins to blossom. Will Kairi be able to face “Senki” and forge his own destiny? Kairi's battle to reach the pinnacle of Dark Machine begins now.

The anime has its own unique world setting, which includes Dark Machine being a popular gaming metaverse, and it takes place "in the not too distant future." The anime is planned for global distribution.

The series stars:

• Kenshō Ono as Kairi

• Miyuki Sawashiro as Rudora

• Kōki Uchiyama as Shinn

• Riho Sugiyama as Bran

• Saya Aizawa as Isana

• Yūichi Nakamura as Ajima

• Kazuyuki Okitsu as Myōjin

• Ryōta Suzuki as Ryō

• Genta Nakamura as Kinji

• Sōhei Horikane as Hiru

• Ryūnosuke Watanuki as Nyūdō

• Jun Kousaka as Hachiman

• Minori Suzuki as Bianca

• Rikuya Yasuda as Weiss

• Nao Tōyama as Ark

• Nonoka Ōbuchi as Denebora

• Rei Nakashima as Spica

The staff for the anime's pilot trailer that premiered at Comic-Con International in July 2024 has been confirmed to work on the television anime. Kazumi Terada is directing the anime at Production +h. The overall project credits Code Geass director Gorō Taniguchi as the creative producer, and Macross artist Hidetaka Tenjin as the chief mechanical designer. Keiichi Yano is the project's creator. "Team Carbuncle" — featuring Takaaki Suzuki , Tatsuhiko Urahata , and Atsuo Ishino , — which was listed for writing credits in the pilot trailer, is in charge of the anime's series scripts with the addition of Satohito Sata . BUCK-TICK performs the opening theme song "Sonzai Riyū Kai" (Reason to Live, Renewed).

Other staff members include:

• Main Character Designer: Kō Yoshinari

• Sub-Character Designer: Akira Mitani

• Costume Design: Mebachi

• Chief Animation Directors: Yumi Kuroiwa, Hideki Itō

• storyboard: Masatsugu Arakawa

• Color Key Artist: niko＊miko

• Art Setting: Hiromi Tateiwa, Engawa,Nariyuki Ogi

• Art Directors: Hiromi Tateiwa, Yusuke Ikeda

• CG Director: Akira Inami

• CG Action Director: Ryou Kimura

• Compositing Director of Photography: Naoko Tanaka

• Photography Supervision: Kentarō Waki

• Editing: Yuki Honda

• Sound Director: Takeshi Takadera

• Sound Effects: Tomoko Ohtsuka

• Music: SUGIZO

• Music Production: Flying Dog

The anime has a manga adaptation that launched on Jitsugyo no Nihon Sha, Ltd. 's Comic Ruelle and Comic Jardin on September 24 ahead of its broadcast debut. Kei Kondо̄ is drawing the manga.

The Dark Machine "asynchronous big team arena shooter" game was announced in 2023, and Early Access started in 2024.

Taniguchi is the creative producer on the game, and Tenjin is the chief mechanical designer. Yuya Saito is the game director and Koji Hakuta is the producer. The game is a 7-versus-7 mech third-person shooting game.

The staff raised more than US$8.7 million from more than 6,000 investors including Tencent , web3 game platform Immutable, and blockchain company Sui. The staff are developing the game with Unreal Engine 5. The game features the blockchain-based in-game currency MACHINA ($MXNA), and also features NFT asset ownership and an NFT marketplace for direct sales and peer-to-peer exchanges. Players can install and play the game without having to purchase any NFTs, and get free NFTs to start playing the game. Decentralized tournaments are integral to the gameplay.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan Musical Starts World Tour in Singapore Next April
content:
Attack on Titan : The Musical , the stage musical based on Hajime Isayama 's Attack on Titan manga, announced on Tuesday that the musical will go on a world tour that will begin with a run at the Sands Theatre, Marina Bay Sands in Singapore from April 15 to May 2, 2027. The tour will announce more dates at a later time.

Gō Ueki directs the musical, while Masafumi Hata wrote the book. Hip hop artist KEN THE 390 is the music director, with lyrics by Kaori Miura . The musical combines traditional staging and music with technology to recreate the Attack on Titan world.

title: Hindi Dub of My Hero Academia Anime Streams on Ani-One India YouTube Channel
content:
The anime's eighth and final season debuted in October 2025. Crunchyroll streamed it in India as it aired in Japan and also streamed English and Hindi dubs. Anime Times also streamed the season in India.

Cartoon Network aired the first season anime in India with Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam dubs in September 2023.

The anime's first 13-episode season premiered in April 2016. The 25-episode second season premiered in April 2017, and the third season premiered in April 2018 and ran for 25 episodes. The fourth season premiered in Japan in October 2019, and aired for 25 episodes. A two-episode original video anime for the franchise streamed in Japan in August 2020. The show's fifth season premiered in Japan in March 2021, and aired for 25 episodes. A new two-episode original video anime screened in Japan in June 2022.

The sixth season of My Hero Academia premiered in October 2022. The season aired for two continuous cours (quarter of a year) for a total of 25 episodes. Netflix streamed the season in India as it aired in Japan. Crunchyroll is streaming an English dub of the season. The Hollywood Critics Association's nominated the season for its 2023 TV Awards under the "Best Streaming Animated Series or TV Movie" category.

The anime got a seventh season . Crunchyroll streamed the season in India as it aired in Japan. The Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu dubs of the season began streaming in October 2025.

Kōhei Horikoshi launched the manga series in Weekly Shonen Jump in July 2014, and ended it in August 2024. Viz Media published the manga in English digitally and in print in North America. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service also published the manga in English digitally. The manga's 42nd and final compiled book volume shipped in Japan in December 2024 and included 38 pages of new content that takes place after the original ending.

title: Zavvi Online Store Goes Into Administration
content:
"The Company has ceased trading with immediate effect. The Company is unable to fulfil any outstanding orders or pre-orders. Customers should not place any new orders through the Company's website. Please also note that we are unable to accept any returns for items of any kind."

The message also refers to customers who have paid for goods that have not been received.

"(They) should contact their bank, card issuer or payment provider promptly to establish whether they may be entitled to recover their payment. Depending on the payment method and the circumstances of the transaction, customers may be able to make a claim under section 75 of the Consumer Credit Act 1974, request a chargeback, or use another buyer-protection process."

Zavvi was formerly the rebranded UK retail division of Virgin Megastore, operating under the Zavvi name from 2007 to 2009.

title: MVM Announces New Acquisitions For Early 2027
content:
MVM has announced on its X/Twitter feed that it will release two titles in early 2027 as Collector's Editions: the film Fate/Grand Order Final Singularity - Grand Temple of Time: Solomon (pictured right) and Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Season 5.

The Fate/Grand Order Final Singularity - Grand Temple of Time: Solomon anime adapts the Fate/Grand Order smartphone game's "The Grand Temple of Time Solomon" story, which is the Final Singularity in the game's first part. Toshifumi Akai returned from the previous Fate/Grand Order Absolute Demonic Front: Babylonia anime to direct the new film at CloverWorks , and Kinoko Nasu is credited for the original script.

MVM will also release standard editions of the following four titles: Kizumonogatari: Koyomi Vamp (the compilation film version of the three Kizumonogatari films), Ragna Crimson , Lycoris Recoil and Engage Kiss .
author: ANN
